methodology.question: Can a complete defensive opinion distinguish a rising asset from an observed equity-offsetting asset without assuming that duration or gold is always a hedge?
methodology.complementary_role: One complete policy,not three sleeves relabelled as experts. A positive slow stock context retains an equal six-family equity core. Otherwise defensive eligibility also requires negative observed covariance with stocks. This is different from the admitted relative-strength expert's126-session BIL-excess eligibility,inverse-volatility weights and30-70percentstock bounds.
methodology.economic_limits: Observed negative covariance is not a forecast of the next return,beta,macro inflation regime or future crash protection. Positive own momentum alone doesnot certify hedging. If no asset supplies both pieces of observed evidence,the explicitly declared invested asset is BIL,not free idle interest or a safe successful risk score.
methodology.research_choices: 252trading sessions represents one business year for slow market context;63represents a quarter for current observed hedge coupling. Exactly one fixed law,no horizon,threshold,allocation,cost,precision or source scan. These are assistant research choices,not user-prescribed numbers.
methodology.numeric_law: Daily returns are ordinary binary64 price ratios minus one. Centered cross-product sign is compared as exact rational arithmetic of those original binary64 values;the independent oracle uses common-denominator integers. No fitted covariance inverse,solver,epsilon sign,decimal truncation or rescue of previous terminal numerical identities.
methodology.input_plan: Initial qualification uses the original complete admitted fourteen-asset context and original four full windows. The new synchronized22day block is not silently spliced into old prices or RF. Any newer-data/window experiment requires separately frozen input admission and identity. No market request is needed for this price-only policy.
methodology.clocks_and_availability: Only real completed month ends after252returns of source history define native requests. Preserve all source prehistory. A formal funding anchor can use its actually known prior month-end recommendation;do not invent an earlier initial signal or require full-context first-active to equal every capital anchor.
methodology.execution_and_admission: Future source books retain freshUSD10000,originalRF andinitialpeak,costs,delays,cashfunding andoriginalmonthly2.5ppactualholdingband/independentBT. Technical source admission and pool membership are separate reviews after complete books;preparation doesnot admit an eighth expert. Standalone financial failure alone doesnot invalidate a complete technically admissible expert.
methodology.selection_bias: All235completed configurations and rejected consensus results are exposed. A causal prefix check is not independent OOS or real forward evidence. No ex-post peak/trough date is an input.
